import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', 10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Registrations')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(breed_counts.values):
    ax1.text(v + 100, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Dog Gender Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors_gender = ['#3498db', '#e74c3c', '#95a5a6']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_gender[:len(gender_counts)],
                                    explode=[0.02]*len(gender_counts), startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 3: Dog Registrations by District (Kreis)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors_district = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(district_counts))
ax3.barh(district_counts.index, district_counts.values, color=colors_district)
ax3.set_xlabel('Total Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_title('Dog Registrations by District', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(district_counts.values):
    ax3.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=8)

# Plot 4: Owner Age Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Filter out any null values and get owner age distribution
owner_age = df['AlterV10Lang'].value_counts()
# Sort by the sort column to get proper order
age_order = df.drop_duplicates('AlterV10Lang')[['AlterV10Lang', 'AlterV10Sort']].sort_values('AlterV10Sort')
age_order = age_order['AlterV10Lang'].tolist()
owner_age_sorted = owner_age.reindex([a for a in age_order if a in owner_age.index])

colors_age = sns.color_palette('RdYlGn', len(owner_age_sorted))
bars = ax4.bar(range(len(owner_age_sorted)), owner_age_sorted.values, color=colors_age)
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(owner_age_sorted)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(owner_age_sorted.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Registrations')
ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group')
ax4.set_title('Dog Ownership by Owner Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Add value labels on bars
for i, v in enumerate(owner_age_sorted.values):
    ax4.text(i, v + 200, str(v), ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
